review_method: SHA-256 and page-count verification against each repository PDF
Visual review of PDF cover, independent auditor report, report signature date, and first statement page
OCR used as a reading aid; visual source pages remain authoritative

global_decisions.decision: Source cover, auditor report, and statement pages control title, reporting date, framework, and assurance classification. Filename text and PDF metadata never override visible source content.
All eight documents are classified as audited because each contains an independent auditor report stating that the source was audited and presenting an unmodified present-fairly opinion.

The PDFs do not establish municipal publication, adoption, or final-release status. All eight records remain publication_or_adoption_status=unknown and are blocked from publication until a later gate supplies authority.
Gate 1 does not select one document's comparative value over another. Every comparative remains document-owned until exact observation relationships are reviewed.
